tasks.title: Calibrate source-mode follow-ups for ambiguous references
tasks.summary: Explicit file/task resolution, ambiguity before active-task reuse, and durable reference state are implemented. Next review the eight development chains, commit the source, and capture the reviewed checks against that snapshot before marking this task verified.

evidence.quote: The smallest next repository-chat task is source-mode follow-up calibration:
Explicit task IDs and file paths are resolved before an active task is reused.

A deterministic initial
conversation loop does not establish robust follow-up behavior for arbitrary prose.
Failed/cancelled message pairs never become completed conditioning context.

tasks.doneWhen: Reviewed development cases distinguish a single active task from competing file/topic references, completed history survives restart, unsupported references ask for clarification, and a captured verification report records the checks for the same source commit.

tasks.title: Review source support across broader repository question families
tasks.summary: Review whether selected excerpts support the claims asked about, including unsupported questions and paraphrases. Freeze acceptance families before making retrieval changes.

evidence.quote:
Lexical similarity, centroid distance and token
probability are not factual confidence.

Keep development examples separate from frozen acceptance families and keep all
gold assertions outside the searchable snapshot.

tasks.doneWhen: A reviewed report identifies question-family coverage, numerator and denominator for support and abstention, failed IDs, pinned snapshot identity and independent acceptance results.

tasks.title: Enforce and measure total worker process memory
tasks.summary: Measure native and JavaScript worker allocations together and define an enforceable total-process limit before larger training workloads.

evidence.quote:
The 512 MiB
child JavaScript heap limit does not enforce total process or native memory usage.

tasks.doneWhen: A bounded stress workload records peak total process memory, limit enforcement, cancellation cleanup and API responsiveness on named hardware.

tasks.title: Develop a reviewed centroid dialogue training corpus
tasks.summary: Collect licensed, reviewed dialogue examples with source-separated training and evaluation families. Preserve the existing frozen neural evaluation and report generalization separately from training fit.

evidence.quote: The documented fixed six-case neural dialogue evaluation scores 0/6 exact answers.
Learning the two demo answers checks training fit, not conversational generalization.

tasks.doneWhen: Corpus provenance, review decisions and family boundaries are recorded, training converges on development examples, and untouched acceptance results are reported without claiming generalization from training fit.
